item.title: Opportunity for students
item.description:
We are exploring how to bring students into our niche field of quantitative power trading in the US. That could be as a student worker, as a collaboration on an ambitious master thesis, or a mix of both.

Ideally you are a university student who is eager to learn, and who is excited by algorithmic trading, statistical modelling and optimization.

You would be part of a tiny team — Søren and Thomas — with technical PhD backgrounds in computer science and electrical engineering, based in the centre of the Aalborg University campus. We have extensive experience supervising students, both technically and academically.

item.title: Now live in CAISO
item.description:
We completed the application process through the summer, and qnti.fyi has been accepted as a member of CAISO.

This is our third ISO in North America within a year, after ISO-NE in December 2023 and MISO in July 2024.

It is also our last market entrance of 2024. We now turn our focus to integrating these markets into our infrastructure.

item.title: Member of MISO
item.description:
We became a member of MISO on 1 July 2024, and executed our first virtual trade the same day.

It is a big milestone for us, as MISO is the second ISO we have entered, and it is more than five times larger in daily volume than our first ISO, ISO-NE.

From start to finish we completed the application in less than 45 days. Our ambition is to become a member of each of the seven ISOs in the US, and we hope to announce our third membership soon.
